name: Gloomwood

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Blighted Aura
traits.summary: The ground in a 20-ft Emanation is Difficult Terrain; a creature that ends its turn there takes 1d10 Necrotic.
traits.text: The ground in a 20-foot Emanation around the gloomwood is Difficult Terrain, overgrown with mushrooms and fungus. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Carved Past
traits.summary: An action with a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve its old forest's Sylvan name into its trunk stops its Fungal Fling and Spore Stomp until it finishes a Long Rest.
traits.text: As an action, a creature can use a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve the Sylvan name of the gloomwood's ancient home into its trunk. Until the gloomwood finishes a Long Rest, it can't use its Fungal Fling or Spore Stomp actions.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.summary: Ignores Difficult Terrain made by plants or fungi.
traits.text: The gloomwood ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two attacks, Slam or Fungal Fling in any mix.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: +10, reach 10 ft, 2d6+6 Bludgeoning plus 2d6 Necrotic; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled in a branch (escape DC 16, two branches) and Restrained.
actions.text: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. A Medium or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of two branches, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Spore Stomp

damage.when: the attack's target, on a hit
every creature in the 20-ft sphere around the target, hit or miss; half on a successful save

actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Melee +10: 2d10+6 Bludgeoning on a hit; hit or miss, everyone in a 20-ft sphere around the target makes a DC 15 Con save or takes 8d8 Poison (half on a success) and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 feet. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Hit or Miss: each creature within a 20-foot Sphere centered on the target makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 15). Failure: 36 (8d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage only.

summary: A blighted treant that rots the ground around it, flings fungus, grips foes in its branches and stomps out a cloud of poison spores; carving its home forest's name quiets it.
